description: Production' collection (WP2.3): a group of related fields modelled as its own Subject.

Creator in Production Event.description: This field is used to link the documented production activity to an actor responsible for carrying it out.

Location of Production Event.description: This field is used to link the documented production activity to a location at which it was carried out.

Object used in Production Event.description: This field is used to link the documented production activity to an instance of physical object used in the exercise of this activity in a manner consequential to its outcome.

Production Event Technique.description: This field is used to indicate a kind of technique used in the execution of the documented  production activity.

Related Event Causal to Production Event.description: This field is used to link the documented production activity to another event which was the causal reason behind its coming to be.

Production Event Type.description: This field is used to record the formal type of the documented production activity.

Production Event Source Reference.description: This field is used to link the documented production activity to a textual source which documents the activity itself.

Date of Production Event.description: This field is used to link the documented production activity to an instance of time-span recording the temporal extent of the activity.
